note: External Hreflang adds a single Metatag tag plugin, id 'hreflang_external' (label 'External Hreflang', group advanced, multiple=TRUE), for declaring rel=alternate hreflang links to OTHER domains. It has no admin page of its own - you set it inside Metatag. Value syntax is one alternate per line, langcode|url (tokens supported). Values are stored where Metatag stores tags: the metatag_defaults config entities (global, front, node, node__article, ...) under tags.hreflang_external, or on an entity's metatag field. output() emits <link rel=alternate hreflang=code href=url>. It also feeds hook_simple_sitemap_links_alter(). Requires the metatag module. Medium/hard cases are grounded in the real metatag_defaults 'global' tags.hreflang_external config.

evals.prompt: Using the External Hreflang Drupal module, how do I add an alternate hreflang link pointing at a page on another domain, and what syntax do I enter in the field?
evals.expected_output: It adds an 'External Hreflang' field to Metatag forms. Enter one alternate per line as langcode|url, e.g. en-US|https://us.example.com. Each line becomes <link rel="alternate" hreflang="en-US" href="https://us.example.com">.

evals.prompt: Which module does External Hreflang depend on and integrate with, and what is the Metatag tag id (and group) it provides?
evals.expected_output: It requires and integrates with the Metatag module; it provides the Metatag tag plugin 'hreflang_external' (label 'External Hreflang') in the 'advanced' group, configured on any Metatag form. It has no configuration page of its own.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, an external alternate hreflang has been configured in the global Metatag defaults with External Hreflang. Inspect the live configuration and report the external URL it points to.
evals.expected_output: The global metatag defaults set tags.hreflang_external to 'en-us|https://global.exthreflang-probe.example' (drush cget metatag.metatag_defaults.global).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the global Metatag defaults declare more than one external alternate hreflang via External Hreflang. Inspect the live configuration and list the external URLs configured.
evals.expected_output: The global metatag defaults tags.hreflang_external has two lines: en-us|https://us.exthreflang-probe.example and es-es|https://es.exthreflang-probe.example.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, use the External Hreflang module to declare, in the global Metatag defaults, an alternate hreflang 'fr-ca' pointing at https://fr-ca.exthreflang-task.example. Apply the change to the live configuration.
evals.expected_output: Set tags.hreflang_external on the global metatag_defaults to include the line 'fr-ca|https://fr-ca.exthreflang-task.example' (via the Global Metatag form's External Hreflang field, or by editing metatag_defaults 'global' tags and saving).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the global Metatag defaults currently declare an external alternate hreflang for German pointing at https://de.exthreflang-toggle.example (via External Hreflang). Remove that external hreflang alternate. Apply the change to the live configuration.
evals.expected_output: Remove the de-de|https://de.exthreflang-toggle.example line from tags.hreflang_external on the global metatag_defaults and save (clear the External Hreflang field on the Global Metatag form).
